snippet.title: Many Mini Things - Gameplay Demo
snippet.description:
Are you ready for bite-sized games and wacky humor, all at the swipe of your hand? Many Mini Things is a game about just that: many little capsule toys that you win by completing many mini games. Using the motion control capabilities of the Leap Motion controller, you have to move, grab, swipe, and more to complete the series of quick challenges. You’ll experience amazing success – or hilarious failure.

Check us out at 
http://games.massdigi.org/manyminithings
http://www.facebook.com/manyminithings
http://www.twitter.com/manyminithings

Disclaimer: This trailer shows in-game footage that is still in development.
